note: Vocabulary for the unit layer. Data, not code: the role grammar, the dataset families and the derivation domains are all edits here. A name absent from this file is reported as `other`/`unknown` rather than guessed, because an invented classification is invisible once it is stored.
sources: cache/metadata/datafields/*.json for field -> dataset (4417 fields, 14 datasets, 373/373 of the fields the ledger uses are covered)

opaque.note: Cleaning operators: they decide how a value is measured, not what bet it is. Folding them keeps `ts_backfill(x, 252)` and `x` in one role.

roles.note: Ordered: the first operator that matches the call decides. {0} is the role of argument 0.

binary.note: How a binary operator reads as a role. `mix` covers + and - because a sign is carried in the assembly, not in the leg.

datasets.note: Dataset id -> family. The family is what a unit is grouped by; the dataset id stays on the expression for provenance.

domains.note: Which fields may fill a carrier slot when a domain is explicitly expanded. Only fields whose dataset is listed here, and only for slots whose observed fillings are all in that dataset. Expanding a domain is an offer, never something derived silently.
